headline_statement: If a cap-one scalar H is independent of a planar vector with joint density cap M, the symmetric 3x3 Hessian has sigma_min>=sigma, and |T_HH|<=r sigma for any fixed r<1, then ||p_Q||inf<=B(r,M)/sigma with B(r,M)=1+M[2/sqrt(1-r^2)+2+G0 sqrt(5+(1+2r)^2/(1-r^2))], G0=(2pi)^(3/2)e^(1/2)Gamma(1/4)/(4sqrt(pi)Gamma(3/4)).
concrete_new_range: For M=2 and normalized hub ratio r=1/2, the theorem gives ||p_Q||inf<79.287/sigma for every such three-variable core; the fresh cited source stated only the very-small-ratio receiver.
exact_graph_application: Inherited true-near-coloop exact-graph data give sigma_min(C)^2>=rho0=(1/32)/(1+1/sqrt(63))^2=0.02464803918 and normalized hub ratio r0<=0.6339246656, hence the valid bound <3656/s. Late source refresh indicates the broader interactive exact-rank-three matroid/coarea package may already subsume this corollary, so do not count the corollary as uniquely new progress without source-map audit.
